name: Verdura Resort, Rocco Forte Private Villas
positioning: Three- and four-bedroom private villas at Rocco Forte's Verdura Resort, a golf and spa resort on Sicily's southern coast
best_for: Families or groups wanting a three- or four-bedroom villa by the sea
Golfers who want to stay beside the resort's Kyle Phillips-designed links courses
Food lovers interested in Fulvio Pierangelini's menus, from Sicilian trattoria dishes to Japanese-influenced dining

facts.text: Verdura Resort is on Sicily's southern coast.
The three-bedroom Agata villas have views of the Verdura golf course, the white-sand shoreline and the sea.
The Topazio four-bedroom villas are spread across two floors.
The Corallo villas are sea-front four-bedroom villas over two floors with uninterrupted views of the southern Sicilian sea.
The resort's links-style golf courses span 230 hectares of Sicilian coastline.
The restaurants and bars are connected to the resort's own farm, with menus by Fulvio Pierangelini ranging from Italian classics to Japanese cuisine.
Nagori applies Japanese techniques to Mediterranean produce through seasonal menus.
Amare serves fresh seafood on the beachfront.
Zagara's seasonal ingredients are handpicked from the resort's organic garden, including Verdura olive oil.
L'Osteria is an all-day, sea-facing restaurant using farm-grown produce and the day's catch from Sciacca.
Scirocco Bar's hand-painted walls are the creative vision of Paolo Moschino and Philip Vergeylen, painted by artist Phyllis Clair Smith.
The resort's flagship spa uses homegrown botanicals and draws on longevity wisdom from the blue zone of nearby Caltabellotta.

highlights.text: Verdura Resort offers three- and four-bedroom villas overlooking the Mediterranean Sea and the Sicilian countryside.
The Topazio villas overlook a large private pool in a leafy garden, with the sea on the horizon.
The Smeraldo villas are sea-front three-bedroom villas with front-row views of the resort's shoreline.
The resort has two championship golf courses and a nine-hole par-3 course, designed by Kyle Phillips as a links experience by the sea.
Nagori, Fulvio Pierangelini's most intimate restaurant, is inside the ancient Saracen Tower.

considerations.text: Some restaurants are seasonal: Zagara serves dinner from March to November, and Nagori serves dinner from June to October.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires planned transportation.
